steps.name: Install pinned validation and guest tools
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
cargo fetch --locked

steps.name: Test standalone validation and process ownership
Qualify proposed transaction shapes with the maintained Rust compiler and HTTP preparation
steps.run:
python3 tools/generate_transaction_contracts.py --check
python3 tools/qualify_transaction_contracts.py --language rust --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/transaction-contract-rust"
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib values::tests::transactions -- --nocapture

steps.name: Exercise developer cache with the actual operator and compiled Rust package inputs
Test contract derivation and isolated provenance approvals
steps.run:
cargo test --locked -p latent-packaging semantics::authoring
cargo test --locked -p latent-signing --test guest_provenance
